Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning bail for persons in custody.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to bail for persons in custody; and adding a newsection to chapter 10.19 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 10.19 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A person who is held in custody and is alleged to have committed acrime against a person, when the crime is a felony, shall appear beforea judicial officer for an individualized determination of pretrialrelease conditions prior to the person's release from custody if theoffense is bailable.
